details: The zoom handler correctly coalesces renders via RAF and scales are properly re-derived each frame using `transform.rescaleX(xScale)` on immutable base scales. However, `drawPoints` starts enter/exit transitions (200ms/150ms) without calling `.interrupt()` first, so rapid zoom events mid-transition can cause conflicting animations on entering/exiting circles; the mode-switch fade-out (`pointLayer.selectAll('*').transition()...`) also lacks interrupt guards.
